thesis: PGNY is extended after a post-earnings gap in a market that is risk-off with VIX at the 99.5th percentile and QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages. Price is 8.2% above the 20-day SMA with RSI 67, and it has made three lower highs and lower closes since the 52-week high. Consensus upside is only about 6% to the mean target, and resistance at 37.21 is 1.76 above the last price, so the first leg has almost no room. The re-rating rests on a quant rank upgrade and one print, with revenue down sequentially and no guidance detail in the packet. If the gap fills, the post-earnings base near 33 is the first support, and a failed breakout would likely retest the 20-day SMA.
